belgium-flanders-mo-anki-deck.hook: Pass the MO test at the end of your inburgering course and learn the Dutch words you meet at the gemeente, VDAB and school. 165 short Dutch question-and-answer cards cover institutions, rights and duties, work, education, health, history and daily life in Flanders. Everyday services you will actually use: what the VDAB does, why you must join a mutualiteit, how to buy a De Lijn ticket, and the 1712 helpline for domestic violence.
State structure in one place: three regions, three communities, the Kamer and a 60-member Senaat after the sixth state reform, and why 21 July is the national holiday.
Short Dutch answers you can say aloud, so the deck doubles as civic vocabulary for your Dutch course.
$9 once, no subscription. Works in Anki desktop, AnkiMobile and AnkiDroid.
inside: One .apkg file with 165 Dutch question-and-answer cards with short answers. Delivered instantly through Gumroad.

faqs.q: What does the deck cover, and what does it not?
faqs.a: 165 short Dutch cards on Belgian and Flemish institutions, rights and duties, work, education, health, nationality, history, geography and daily life. It is a review tool for the MO themes. It does not replace the mandatory MO course, Dutch lessons or the course evaluation.

faqs.q: What is the MO test format in Flanders?
faqs.a: After the MO course you take a computer-based multiple-choice test of up to 120 minutes. You need at least 70% overall and at least 80% on the values and norms questions. The test counts for 60% of your MO result and the course evaluation for 40%.

faqs.q: Is there a free practice test for the MO test?

faqs.q: Do I have to take the MO test in Dutch?
faqs.a: No. The agency offers the MO course in 38 languages, and you take the test in your own language or a language you understand. These cards are in Dutch, so they suit you best if you already read some Dutch or want to learn the civic terms in Dutch.

examFacts.label: Level D
examFacts.value: Year 7 in England and Wales (S1 in Scotland, Year 8 in Northern Ireland); norms cover ages 10:06 to 12:11

examFacts.label: Structure
examFacts.value: 4 batteries (verbal, quantitative, non-verbal, spatial) with 2 short tests each, taken in three parts of about 45 minutes

examFacts.label: Subtests in this product
examFacts.value: Verbal Classification and Verbal Analogies (8 minutes each), Number Analogies (10 minutes), Number Series (8 minutes)

examFacts.label: Results
examFacts.value: No pass or fail: schools get Standard Age Scores (average 100) and stanines for each battery

cat4-level-d-anki-pdf.factsNote: Level, year groups and age band from GL Assessment's CAT4 support pages (choosing a level; what is in each battery; what happens on the day), checked October 2026.
cat4-level-d-anki-pdf.whoFor: Parents and tutors of children sitting CAT4 Level D in Year 7, at UK secondary or international schools, who want short daily practice on the verbal and number question types plus printed sheets for timed sessions.
whyThis: Equal depth on all four subtests: Verbal Classification, Verbal Analogies, Number Analogies and Number Series each get 2 method cards and 48 worked examples.
Every worked example shows five options like the real test, then the answer and a one-line rule, for example 'each second number is double the first'.
Screen and paper: Anki spaces the reviews automatically, and the PDF puts four examples on each page for timed practice away from devices.
Method cards teach one repeatable first move per subtest: name the rule before looking at the options.
Original CAT4-style items written for this product; no copied GL Assessment questions.
inside: Anki deck (.apkg, 200 cards): 8 method cards (2 per subtest) and 192 worked examples, 48 per subtest, each with five options, the answer, method steps and an explanation.
Printable PDF (49 A4 pages, 4 examples per page): the same 192 worked examples with the answer and an insight line on every item.
Subtests covered: Verbal Classification, Verbal Analogies, Number Analogies, Number Series.
Not included: Figure Classification, Figure Matrices, Figure Analysis and Figure Recognition (the non-verbal and spatial batteries), and no full timed mock.
Items run from warm-up to standard level, and most number series follow a single rule, so stronger pupils should add harder mixed practice in the final weeks.
cat4-level-d-anki-pdf.samplesNote: The gallery screenshots are real items from the product, shown as Anki cards and as a page of the printable PDF, not mock-ups.
studyPlan: Start with the 8 method cards so your child can say the first move for each subtest out loud.
Review 10 to 15 Anki cards a day, five days a week; Anki brings back the patterns your child gets wrong.
Once a week, print a PDF block and time it with the real limits: 8 minutes for a verbal or number series block, 10 for number analogies.
In the final week, mix PDF blocks from all four subtests and redo only the patterns that were missed.

faqs.q: Is this the official CAT4?
faqs.a: No. These are original CAT4-style practice items that follow GL Assessment's published subtest formats. The product is by Prep2Go and is not affiliated with GL Assessment.

faqs.q: Does it cover the whole CAT4?
faqs.a: No. It covers the verbal and quantitative batteries, four of the eight subtests. The non-verbal and spatial tests use figures and are not included.

faqs.q: Is it worth preparing for CAT4 at all?
faqs.a: CAT4 measures reasoning, and many schools advise against heavy coaching. Knowing the question types still reduces surprises on the day, and this pack gives that familiarity in short sessions.

faqs.q: What age is Level D for?
faqs.a: Year 7 in England and Wales, S1 in Scotland and Year 8 in Northern Ireland. GL Assessment's norms for Level D cover ages 10 years 6 months to 12 years 11 months.

faqs.q: How do we use the Anki file?
faqs.a: Install free Anki on a computer and use File, Import to open the .apkg. To review on a phone, sync with a free AnkiWeb account and use AnkiDroid (free) or AnkiMobile (iOS).

faqs.q: Can I share it with other families?
faqs.a: The license covers one household. Tutors working with several families should buy one copy per family.

cat4-level-d-anki-pdf.disclaimer: Independent CAT4-style practice material by Prep2Go. Not affiliated with GL Assessment; CAT4 is a trademark of its owner. Personal use by one household; no redistribution.

ib-biology-sl-anki.hook: Revise IB Biology SL with 149 Anki cards that explain rather than just define. Each card names a concept, gives the process step by step, adds an example or calculation (Hardy-Weinberg carrier frequency, a chi-squared test) and shows a labeled diagram, such as the stages of mitosis or the heart's conduction system.

examFacts.label: Awarded by
examFacts.value: International Baccalaureate (IB), May and November sessions; final grade 1 to 7

examFacts.label: Paper 1 (SL)

examFacts.label: Paper 2 (SL)
examFacts.value: 1 hour 30 minutes, 44%: data-based and short-answer questions plus one extended response from a choice of two

examFacts.label: Internal assessment
examFacts.value: Scientific investigation, 20%: a written report of up to 3,000 words

examFacts.label: Syllabus
examFacts.value: First assessed 2025, organized into four themes: Unity and diversity, Form and function, Interaction and interdependence, Continuity and change

ib-biology-sl-anki.factsNote: Assessment model from the IB DP Biology subject brief and guide (first assessment 2025), checked October 2026. Calculators are allowed in both SL papers.
ib-biology-sl-anki.whoFor: IB Diploma students taking Biology at Standard Level who want a compact daily review of core concepts in the months before Paper 1 and Paper 2, and HL students who want a quick refresher on the shared core.
whyThis: Explanations, not one-word answers: the action potential card walks through depolarization to +40 mV, repolarization, hyperpolarization and the sodium-potassium pump.
Worked numbers where the papers use them: cystic fibrosis carrier frequency from Hardy-Weinberg (about 1 in 26) and a chi-squared test on a 3:1 cross.
A labeled illustration on every card gives a visual anchor for processes like mitosis, the cardiac cycle and membrane transport.
Small enough to finish: at 10 new cards a day, the whole deck is introduced in about two weeks.
inside: One Anki deck (.apkg, about 6 MB). Front: the concept. Back: the definition or process, an example line and a labeled illustration.
Coverage: biological molecules and enzymes, cells and membranes, DNA, gene expression and inheritance, cell division, photosynthesis and respiration.
Human physiology (blood, heart, nerves, hormones, immunity, kidney), plant transport and responses, ecology, evolution and classification.
Skills cards on experimental design, statistics, graph interpretation and microscopy calculations.
5 extension cards marked HL: lac operon, signal transduction, apoptosis, immune evasion and genetic technology.
Cards follow a topic order, not the 2025 syllabus codes (A1.1, B2.3 and so on), and a few go beyond SL. Not included: past-paper questions or IA guidance.
ib-biology-sl-anki.samplesNote: The gallery screenshots are real cards from the shipped deck, rendered in Anki with their diagrams, so you can judge the depth of the explanations before buying.
studyPlan: Import the deck and set 10 new cards a day; the full deck is introduced in about 15 days.
Before flipping a process card, say the steps out loud (stages of mitosis, steps of an action potential), then check yourself.
Redo every calculation card on paper as practice for the data questions in Paper 1B and Paper 2.
In the last month, pair daily reviews with past papers from your school and add your own cards for any gap the papers reveal.

faqs.q: Does it follow the syllabus first assessed in 2025?
faqs.a: It covers core biology the current SL course still assesses, but it is organized by traditional topics rather than the four new themes, and a few cards go beyond SL. Check unfamiliar cards against your teacher's syllabus list.

faqs.q: Will this deck get me a 7?
faqs.a: No single resource can. The deck builds fast recall of definitions and processes, which every paper needs; you still need past-paper practice for data analysis and extended responses, and a strong scientific investigation.

faqs.a: Yes. Each of the 149 cards includes a labeled illustration, which is why the file is about 6 MB. The images sync to your phone with the deck.

faqs.q: Is it useful for HL students?
faqs.a: For the shared core, yes. Only 5 cards cover HL extension topics, so HL students will need other material for the additional higher level content.

faqs.q: Can I use it on my phone?

faqs.a: No. Independent study deck by Prep2Go, not affiliated with, sponsored or approved by the International Baccalaureate Organization.

life-and-health-insurance-exam-anki-deck.whoFor: Candidates for a state Life & Health (or Life-only / Accident & Health) producer license who are in a pre-licensing course and want the national core terms locked in: policy types, provisions, riders, annuities, health plans, disability, long-term care and Medicare. whyThis: Every card names the trap: grace period vs free look, own-occupation vs any-occupation disability, COBRA 18 vs 36 months, Medigap does not replace Medicare.
About 75 scenario cards run real cases: a $40,000 annuity withdrawal taxed LIFO plus the 10% penalty, a Part B late penalty of 30%, the birthday rule, a 7-pay test failure.
Health plans and Medicare (50 of them) plus provisions and riders (40) are the largest groups: HSA vs HRA vs FSA, COBRA, settlement options, reinstatement, suicide clause.
Compact: 250 cards take about 10 days at 25 new cards a day, then 10-minute daily reviews until your exam date.
$29 once for an .apkg you keep. Works offline in Anki desktop, AnkiMobile and AnkiDroid; no subscription and no login.
inside: 250 unique front/back Anki cards, no repeated copies. Front: a concept question or a short client scenario. Back: the rule and why it applies, an example and a common-mistake line. 17 of them add a formula line.

By topic: Health plans, cost sharing & Medicare 50 · Life policy types & underwriting 40 · Policy provisions & riders 40 · Tax, regulation & producer ethics 32 · General insurance principles 30 · Annuities 30 · Disability & LTC 28.
Every card is tagged by topic (ins-health, ins-annuities, ins-provisions and so on), so you can filter one weak area in Anki's browser or build a custom study session.
Not included: your state's insurance-law section, a multiple-choice question bank, video, or pre-licensing course text. Pair the deck with your course and the free timed mock.

studyPlan: Take the free Life & Health readiness check (60 questions, 90 minutes, 70% target) and write down your two weakest topic areas.
Filter those topics by tag and learn them first at 25 new cards a day; the full deck takes about 10 days.
Say the common-mistake line out loud before you flip. Many exam distractors are exactly those swaps: primary vs contingent, term vs whole life, Part A vs Part B.
Study your state's insurance-law chapters from your pre-licensing course; the deck covers the national core only.

faqs.q: What does the Life & Health deck cover, and what does it not?
faqs.a: 250 cards on the national core of Life & Health producer exams: risk and contract basics, life policy types and underwriting, provisions and riders, annuities, health plans and Medicare, disability and LTC, tax and producer ethics. It does not cover your state's insurance law and is not a question bank; use it with your pre-licensing course.

faqs.q: What is the Life & Health insurance exam format?
faqs.a: It depends on the state. Texas, for example, uses Pearson VUE: 145 questions (130 scored, 15 unscored pretest) in 150 minutes, with a scaled passing score of 70 set by TDI. Other states use PSI or Prometric and set their own question count, time and cut score, so check your state's candidate handbook.

faqs.q: I am only taking a Life-only exam. Is the deck still useful?
faqs.a: Yes. Life-only candidates can suspend the health and disability tags (78 of the 250) and focus on life policy types, provisions and riders, annuities and tax. Filter by tag in Anki's browser and study the rest.

whyThis: California rules, not a national deck: community property, grant deeds, nonjudicial foreclosure and deficiency limits, TDS and NHD, Megan's Law, water heater bracing, the Recovery Fund.

Weighted toward the exam: Practice & Disclosures is the largest group (51 of them: trust funds, advertising, team names, fair housing, deposits), then Ownership 49 and Agency 38.

faqs.a: 250 cards across the DRE's 7 salesperson areas, with California rules on ownership, agency, disclosures, deeds, escrow, financing and Prop 13, plus 12 formula cards. It is not a question bank or a pre-license course; use it with your Principles and Practice courses and practice exams.

faqs.q: What is the California DRE salesperson exam format?
faqs.a: Per the DRE: 150 multiple-choice questions with four choices in 3 hours, taken electronically at a DRE exam center. You need at least 70% correct (105 of 150). Passing candidates are not told their score; unsuccessful candidates get their score and results by subject area.
